about_the_game:
DuNo is a music game platform where everyone can create, share, and play content such as songs and note charts.

Compared to other music games, there will be fewer songs and note charts added by the developers. However, instead, we will focus on developing the core features of the game and maintaining and expanding the community. The goal is to build an engaging community centered around user-created content.

Game Features

  • A beautifully designed and highly customizable gameplay experience that reflects feedback from test players.

  • A wide collection of adorable character illustrations by popular Japanese illustrators.

  • Rich community features that allow players to constantly enjoy new songs and note charts.

  • Completely free to play forever.

Community Features

The following community features are planned:

  • Composers can upload their own original songs.

  • Players can browse and download uploaded songs and create note charts for them.

  • Created note charts can be shared publicly. Even if you don’t create your own, you can search for popular note charts, download, and enjoy them.

  • A ranking system for individual note charts and an overall game rating system will be available for players who want to compete in skill.

Why is it Free?

I have been an independent game developer for over 15 years, primarily creating free games.

This project is a challenge for me as I develop a large-scale game, but I see it as a learning experience to acquire new skills. Once this project is stable, I plan to work on paid game releases as well.

As for the necessary expenses, they are covered by generous contributions from supporters.
